title: Tons of deletions and unsuccessful insertion into database, e.g. Treatments
body:
Starting at midnight today my logfiles are clogged up with messages of record removals, reloads, and unsuccessful inserts.
I upgraded to AAPS2.7  and started it at  2020-09-29T12:09:39Z.
I attach the last log before midnight and the first one after with the problems.

[AndroidAPS._2020-09-29_12-09-39_.8.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/5304815/AndroidAPS._2020-09-29_12-09-39_.8.zip)

[AndroidAPS._2020-09-30_00-00-01_.0.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/5304799/AndroidAPS._2020-09-30_00-00-01_.0.zip)

comments.body: Sorry, my error in the UTC time stamp: the start of AAPS2.7 was at 2020-09-29T10:09:39Z

One thing that may have had an influence: last night I changed the AAPS language from English to German and back a few times so I could see the German terms to help with the translation effort in the docs.
It appears noo one is loking here but in Milos repo.
